title: The blue line's example date follows the location you work in
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role, working in {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • You are enrolled at {Location-B}, in a time zone where today's date is already {Date-B} while it is still {Date-A} at {Location-A}. Run the case at a time of day when the two dates differ.
    For example: {Location-A} is in Edmonton, {Location-B} is in Auckland, {Date-A} is Oct 21 and {Date-B} is Oct 22.
  • Today's date on the calendar of {Location-A} is {Date-A}.
    For example: {Date-A} is Oct 21.
  • Starting screen: the Credit Terms page (Settings, then "Credit Terms" in the Finance group) is open on the Active tab.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Click "New Credit Term".
  2. Type 14 in the Days box.
  3. Click "Cancel".
  4. Switch location to {Location-B} with the location switcher.
  5. Click "New Credit Term".
  6. Type 14 in the Days box.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the "New Credit Term" window opens.
  • Step 2: the blue line reads "… An invoice dated {Date-A} is due …" ({Date-A} plus 14 days).
  • Step 3: the window closes.
  • Step 4: the app now works in {Location-B}.
  • Step 5: the "New Credit Term" window opens.
  • Step 6: the blue line now reads "… An invoice dated {Date-B} is due …" ({Date-B} plus 14 days).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11672 (Story 3, Create or edit a credit term)

  • S3-R5: “While the chosen box holds a valid number, a blue information line below the options explains the term, using today's date as the example invoice date (S3-R16):”
